profile.headline: Software Engineer L5, (iOS) at Netflix
profile.summary:
Technologies: iOS, Swift, Objective C, Server-driven UI (SDUI), C, Javascript, Java, HTML, Android.
Experienced architecting and leading the creation front-end mobile application features with a recent emphasis on server-driven UI (SDUI), maintaining and upgrading legacy codebases, and enabling rapid development and experimentation.
